cross_references.title: Fourteenth Amendment — Due Process and Equal Protection
cross_references.note: Section 7(a) tracks the Fourteenth Amendment's due process and equal protection guarantees but is independently enforceable and can be interpreted more broadly by California courts.

cross_references.title: Inalienable Rights
cross_references.note: Section 1 declares inalienable rights including liberty and privacy. Section 7 provides the procedural and equal protection framework that enforces those rights against government deprivation.

cross_references.title: Civil Action for Deprivation of Rights
cross_references.note: Section 1983 provides a federal cause of action for Fourteenth Amendment violations by state actors. State § 7 claims run in parallel — the federal claim under the Fourteenth Amendment via § 1983, the state claim directly under § 7.
